text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, vasopressin is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 161 vials (36.7 days on hand at 4.4 vials per day). Corvale General holds 185 vials (29.3 days on hand at 6.3 vials per day). The current product label names Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC (FEI 3014288534), a repack plant last inspected VAI on 2024-09-11.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows vasopressin is not listed as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory provides approximately one month of supply at both sites. No FDA shortage designation exists. Alternate manufacturers are available but not all have verifiable plant inspection data.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue purchasing from current contracted supplier; buyer approves.
2. Qualify Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, Inc. as first alternate; plant Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited-FTO-9 last inspected VAI 2024-05-17; buyer approves.
3. Qualify American Regent, Inc. as second alternate; plant last inspected VAI 2026-06-18; buyer approves.
4. Request plant identification from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc., and Baxter Healthcare Corporation before qualification; buyer approves.

Not recommended: No allocation or conservation measures at this time.
